basePrompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: static educational image for an Italian university slide about visual hierarchy. Generate a NEW clean front-facing web interface mockup for booking a physiotherapy appointment. This is example A, deliberately weak uniform visual hierarchy. Landscape 3:2 canvas, pure white background, generous padding, crisp flat UI with readable Italian sans-serif text, slate #334155, faint gray input rectangles. All text has a similar regular font size and weight, including the heading, summary and action, with no bold primary emphasis. A plain white outlined button uses a thin slate outline. Place the following elements vertically in exactly this order and spell every line exactly: heading 'Visita di fisioterapia'; summary '45 minuti · 50 €'; label 'Orario'; read-only input value 'Martedì · 18:00'; label 'Nome'; read-only input value 'Viola'; full-width action button 'Prenota la visita'. The text is essential, large and crystal clear. The form should occupy most of the image with modest clean margins. No outer rounded card, no outer border or shadow, no photographic scene, no devices, no perspective, no decorative artwork, no additional text, no logos, no badges, no version letter A or B in the image. Do not improve the hierarchy: heading, summary, field labels and CTA are intentionally almost uniform. UI only, sharp professional presentation graphic. Text 'Orario' and 'Nome' must stay above their respective boxes. One single interface, no duplicates.
